text:
ana: Quick note 1 - HW partner (NorthNode) needs marketplace evidence bundle: SOC2 summary, latest pen-test (redacted), vuln CSVs, questionnaire. They want upload presigns by next Tue.

tom: Who's owning redaction and manifest?

liam: I'll do the manifest (NDJSON) and scope.md. avi can do pen redaction.

avi: (typo) avi: I got the pen report. It has internal hostnames on pages 2-3. Will redact and produce `redaction_log.csv`.

security-bot: Scan: pen-2026-03.pdf flagged internal IPs and AWS account IDs. Recommend redaction + legal note.

ana: Legal ok with sharing redacted reports; include `redaction_notice.txt`. Also need control mapping doc.

liam: Manifest fields: filename, type, owner, redacted, sha256, notes. NDJSON so reviewers can grep.

tom: I'll provision temp bucket `rw-evidence-northnode-temp` and presign flow. Presign TTL 48h unless reviewers ask for longer. Sample: `aws s3api create-presigned-post --bucket rw-evidence-northnode-temp --key "soc2/%{filename}" --expires-in 172800`

avi: I'll finish redaction by Fri and upload to GH draft folder.

ana: Action summary: avi -> redaction + redaction_log (due Fri), liam -> manifest + scope (due Fri), tom -> presigns + README (due Mon). Share links when ready.

security-bot: Event logged: marketplace-evidence-northnode-2274500000. TTL set: presign 48h; temp retention 14d.

ana: Thanks team. Keep notes minimal in public artifacts; put sensitive notes only in `redaction_log.csv`.
